final: WITH per_item AS (SELECT order_item_id, AVG(CASE WHEN derived_total_cost IS NOT NULL AND derived_total_cost <> 0 AND product_price IS NOT NULL THEN product_price * 1.0 / derived_total_cost END) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY order_item_id) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_item_avg_ratios, AVG(cnt) AS avg_line_item_count FROM per_item
